title: 找出危险，评估风险
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/10_Module 3 — Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/10_Module 3 — Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜对准一只锥形瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass over an Erlenmeyer flask and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：找出危险，评估风险。

shots.scene: 放大镜、天平、清单三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a magnifying glass, a balance scale weighing risk, and a blank checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 从凭感觉，变成有方法。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一份空白规程，兴奋地比划要把烧瓶换成大号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank procedure sheet and excitedly gestures toward swapping a small flask for a much larger one.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把实验规模一下扩大好几倍。

shots.scene: 阿杰对小研说：这个实验我做过很多次了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student talks confidently to the female graduate student, giving a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 他说：这实验我做过很多次，没事。

shots.scene: 小研拿出一张空白评估表，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls out a blank risk assessment form and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研说：规模变了，得重新评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: “做过很多次”，恰恰最容易出事。

shots.scene: 一个藏在阴影里的危险图标，被放大镜照亮
shots.prompt_en: A hazard symbol hidden in a shadow is revealed under a magnifying glass light. No people.
shots.narration: 没找出来的危险，根本没法控制。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周在实验台边逐一指认危险
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man walk along a lab bench pointing out hazards one by one.
shots.narration: 要在它伤人之前，系统地找出来。

shots.scene: 小烧瓶变成巨大烧瓶的示意，旁边写着×100
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small flask growing into a huge flask with a multiplication arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 2010年1月，美国一所高校的研究生，

shots.scene: 爆炸图标，旁边一只受伤包扎的手
shots.prompt_en: An explosion burst icon beside a bandaged hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 把高能材料合成放大百倍，炸断手指。

shots.scene: 评估表上只勾了毒性一栏，爆炸一栏空着并被红圈
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form with only the toxicity box checked while the explosion box is empty and circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 只评估了毒性，漏掉了爆炸危险。

shots.scene: 多个危害图标围成一圈，每个都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A ring of hazard icons, toxic, flammable, explosive, pressure and electrical, each receiving a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 只评一种危险，其余全无防备。

shots.scene: 一瓶酸，旁边固有的危险标志
shots.prompt_en: A blank-labeled acid bottle with a corrosion pictogram attached as its built-in property. No people.
shots.narration: 危害，是东西本身带的属性。

shots.scene: 危害、暴露、可能性、后果四个图标相加
shots.prompt_en: Four icons joined by plus signs: a hazard pictogram, a hand touching a splash, a dice for likelihood, and an injury icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险，要看暴露、可能性和后果。

shots.scene: 暴露的箭头被一扇门挡住，风险表指针下降
shots.prompt_en: An exposure arrow is blocked by a door, and a risk gauge needle drops to green. No people.
shots.narration: 管住暴露，就管住了风险。

shots.scene: 浓酸瓶关在柜里，柜门紧闭，旁边风险表在绿区
shots.prompt_en: A concentrated acid bottle locked in a closed cabinet, with a risk gauge in the green zone beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 浓酸密封在柜子里：危害高，风险低。

shots.scene: 台面上倾倒浓酸、没戴面罩的图标，风险表进红区
shots.prompt_en: An icon of acid being poured on an open bench by a person without a face shield, with the risk gauge in the red zone. No people.
shots.narration: 台面上倒酸不戴面罩：风险陡增。

shots.scene: 两个场景之间一个等号和一个大于号
shots.prompt_en: The two scenes side by side, with an equals sign under the hazard and a big arrow up under the risk. No people.
shots.narration: 危害没变，变的是暴露方式。

shots.scene: 老周在常年用的试剂前放松地哼着歌
shots.prompt_en: The older man relaxes and hums near a reagent he has used for years.
shots.narration: 认知陷阱，连老手也会中招。

shots.scene: 老手和新手两个人形，老手旁的风险表反而更高
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms, an experienced one and a nervous newcomer; the risk gauge beside the experienced one is higher. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉偏差：多年没出事，就低估危险。

shots.scene: 说明书首页上一个“中等”标记被圈住，后几页藏着骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A data sheet front page with a moderate marker circled, while a skull icon hides on a later page. No people.
shots.narration: 锚定：看到“中等危害”就不往下看。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻到说明书后面几页认真读
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns to the later pages of a blank data sheet and reads carefully.
shots.narration: 说明书要读全，慢性危害常在后面。

shots.scene: 小研对照说明书和瓶上象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares a blank data sheet with the GHS pictograms on a reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 化学品的首要依据，是安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 两瓶试剂倒进烧瓶，生成一个带问号的新物质
shots.prompt_en: Two reagent bottles pour into a flask that produces a new mixture marked with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可它只讲出厂时的样子，

shots.scene: 反应混合物和放大的烧瓶两个问号图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with question marks: a reaction mixture and an enlarged flask. No people.
shots.narration: 管不了你的混合物和放大规模。

shots.scene: 电脑上一张空白化学品清单，随时更新
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a blank chemical inventory list with a live refresh symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要有实时的化学品清单。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在门口用平板拿到清单
shots.prompt_en: The security officer receives a blank inventory list on a tablet at the lab door during an emergency drill.
shots.narration: 没清单要14小时，有清单90秒交消防。

shots.scene: 柜子深处一只落满灰的旧溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: An old dusty solvent bottle at the back of a storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 有些溶剂放久了会生成过氧化物，

shots.scene: 旧瓶旁出现爆炸警示图标
shots.prompt_en: An exploding bomb pictogram appears beside the old solvent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 有的自己会爆，有的浓缩后才可爆。

shots.scene: 把旧瓶放进加热浓缩装置的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of putting the old bottle onto a heating apparatus, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜底旧瓶不测过氧化物就浓缩，危险。

shots.scene: 旧瓶旁一支过氧化物检测试纸图标
shots.prompt_en: A peroxide test strip icon next to the old solvent bottle, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这是典型的爆炸隐患。

shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级上有一个微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: A four-step staircase icon with a microbe icon on each step, increasing in size. No people.
shots.narration: 病原体按风险等级分1到4级，

shots.scene: 四个防护等级的实验室图标，从简单到密闭
shots.prompt_en: Four lab room icons from a simple open bench to a fully sealed facility with airlocks. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全防护水平，规定设施和操作。

shots.scene: 病原体、实验活动、实验室三个图标用锁扣连起来
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by matching locks: a microbe, an activity icon of a pipette, and a lab room with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 防护水平要匹配病原体和具体操作。

shots.scene: 冰箱里排列整齐的样品管，旁边空白登记本
shots.prompt_en: Neatly arranged sample tubes in a lab freezer next to a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 管制病原体和毒素，规定毫无余地。

shots.scene: 一支放错位置的管子被放大镜发现，警示三角亮起
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass finds one misplaced tube, and a yellow warning triangle lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 一支毒素小瓶归档错，引发联邦调查。

shots.scene: 账物相符的天平图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A balance icon with a logbook on one side and tubes on the other, level, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 执法处理，全单位授权缩减，零容错。

shots.scene: 一只气瓶，内部压力用很多箭头表示
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon with many outward pressure arrows inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 典型气瓶内压约6000磅每平方英寸。

shots.scene: 瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭一样冲出的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder with a broken valve shooting forward like a rocket, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 1980年瓶阀断裂，气瓶连穿三堵墙。

shots.scene: 老李用链条把气瓶固定在墙上，戴好瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer secures gas cylinders to a wall with chains and screws on the protective caps.
shots.narration: 气瓶要固定、戴瓶帽、分类存放。

shots.scene: 一小杯液氮冒出大团白雾，扩散成很大一片
shots.prompt_en: A small cup of liquid nitrogen releases a white fog that expands to fill a large area. No people.
shots.narration: 1升液氮，气化成约700升氮气。

shots.scene: 房间里的氧气分子被挤出去
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen molecule icons being pushed out of a room by nitrogen icons. No people.
shots.narration: 它悄悄挤走氧气，人会窒息。

shots.scene: 墙上的氧含量报警器亮灯
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen level monitor on the wall flashing a red alarm light in a liquid nitrogen storage room. No people.
shots.narration: 存放液氮的房间，要装氧含量报警器。

shots.scene: 离心机转子图标带着旋转箭头和能量闪电
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge rotor icon with spinning arrows and an energy bolt symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机像储能飞轮，不平衡会出大事。

shots.scene: 水槽旁的拖线板图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip lying next to a sink with water, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 水源旁边，不能乱拉电线。

shots.scene: 激光警告标志和激光防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: A laser warning sign next to a pair of laser safety eyewear. No people.
shots.narration: 3B类和4类激光，不戴匹配眼镜会致盲。

shots.scene: 电离辐射标志和上锁的储源柜
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation warning sign above a locked source storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 放射源处置不当，罚款治理几十万美元。

shots.scene: 小研把一项新任务拆成几张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student breaks a new task into several blank cards laid out in a row on the bench.
shots.narration: 做新实验，先把任务拆成步骤，

shots.scene: 每张卡片上浮现不同危害图标
shots.prompt_en: Each card shows a different hazard icon: a flask, a microbe, a lightning bolt and a bent back. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步找出化学、生物、物理和人机危害。

shots.scene: 每个危害图标旁配上对应的防护图标
shots.prompt_en: Each hazard icon gets a matching control icon beside it: a fume hood, a safety cabinet, a switch and a lifting aid. No people.
shots.narration: 每个危害配上对应的控制措施。

shots.scene: 卡片装订成一本空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The cards are bound together into a blank procedure booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 这份分析，就是操作规程的骨架。

shots.scene: 四格风险矩阵，颜色从绿到红
shots.prompt_en: A two-by-two risk matrix grid colored from green to red, likelihood on one axis and severity on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 要排优先级，就用风险矩阵。

shots.scene: 红格亮起，旁边出现手套箱和阻燃服图标
shots.prompt_en: The red cell lights up with icons of a glove box and a flame-resistant coat appearing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性大、后果重的，立即整改。

shots.scene: 绿格旁一个眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: The green cell with an eye icon for routine monitoring. No people.
shots.narration: 风险低的，定期监控。

shots.scene: 几个危害家族图标，各配一个控制套餐盒
shots.prompt_en: Several hazard family icons, each paired with a bundled control package box. No people.
shots.narration: 数据不全，按危害类别配套措施。

shots.scene: 一列失效模式卡片，旁边打分
shots.prompt_en: A column of failure mode cards, each with a priority score bar. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险工艺，逐一分析失效方式。

shots.scene: 蝴蝶结形状：中间事件，左边预防屏障，右边减缓屏障
shots.prompt_en: A bow-tie diagram: a central hazard event, prevention barriers on the left, mitigation barriers on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 蝴蝶结图：左边防发生，右边减后果。

shots.scene: 一份评估只在脑子里的思考气泡，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An assessment existing only as a thought bubble, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 在监管眼里，没写下来就是没发生。

shots.scene: 老周在空白评估表上签名、写日期
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs and dates a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 评估要签名、写日期，

shots.scene: 评估表与规程、培训记录用线连起来
shots.prompt_en: The assessment form linked by lines to a blank procedure book and a blank training record. No people.
shots.narration: 和规程、培训记录挂上钩。

shots.scene: 评估表锁在落灰的抽屉里，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An assessment form locked in a dusty drawer, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锁在抽屉里没人看，等于白做。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜看自己的实验台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at its own lab bench through a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 回头看看你上一次实验，

shots.scene: 放大镜下浮现一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A question mark appears under the magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 问问自己：我漏掉了什么危险？

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现危害和风险两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two icons, a hazard pictogram and a risk gauge.
shots.narration: 分清危害和风险，管住暴露。

shots.scene: 化学、生物、物理、辐射四个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Four hazard icons: a chemical bottle, a biohazard warning sign, a gas cylinder and an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理、辐射，一个不漏。

shots.scene: 拆步骤卡片和风险矩阵图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of task step cards and a colored risk matrix. No people.
shots.narration: 拆步骤找危害，用矩阵排优先。

shots.scene: 签名的评估表和循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A signed assessment form with a circular update arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 写下来、签上名，和规程挂钩。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a magnifying glass and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 带着新眼光看实验台，下次见！
